description: Timing profile h(tau) = (1 - tau/W)^P of pre-Election-Day ballots (early_vote.profile_fit): W, P fitted to the 2024 national path; check_2026 = the 2026 path so far (banked share of 2022 turnout) against that shape with its scale free. Source: UF Election Lab national early-vote tables (2024 via Wayback Machine captures); only derived shares are stored.
